articles.title: Malin Åkerman Stars in Timeless Rom-Com 27 Dresses and New Series The Hunting Wives
articles.summary: Malin Åkerman's 2008 rom-com 27 Dresses has proven to be a timeless favorite among audiences, with many fans rewatching the film multiple times. In fact, I've recently confessed my own...
articles.content: Malin Åkerman's 2008 rom-com 27 Dresses has proven to be a timeless favorite among audiences, with many fans rewatching the film multiple times. In fact, I've recently confessed my own guilty pleasure of revisiting the movie, which stars Åkerman as Tess, the charming and free-spirited younger sister of Katherine Heigl's Jane. While some might view Tess as a villain, Åkerman sees her character in a different light. According to Åkerman, Tess is simply a young woman who made mistakes and learned from them, growing into a wiser person as a result. This nuanced understanding of her character is reflected in the way Åkerman has approached other roles, including her portrayal of Margo Banks in The Hunting Wives. Margo, a Texas queen with a penchant for guns and a complicated past, has captivated audiences with her audacity and charm. As a gun-toting, bisexual woman, Margo's character is undeniably complex and multifaceted. Her relationship with Sophie, played by Brittany Snow, adds an extra layer of depth to the show, making it easy to see why audiences are drawn to their Bonnie-and-Clyde-esque love story. The new season of The Hunting Wives promises to deliver even more excitement and tension, as Margo finds herself in increasingly precarious situations. With stakes higher than ever before, fans can expect plenty of twists and turns as the show continues to unfold. Meanwhile, Åkerman's performance as Margo remains a highlight of the series. The actress has spoken about the importance of representing lesbian characters on screen, particularly in a state like Texas where their stories are often overlooked. With The Hunting Wives' return for Season 2, it's clear that Åkerman is committed to bringing these stories to life with authenticity and passion. In fact, Åkerman recently performed at the Las Culturistas Culture Awards alongside Brittany Snow, showcasing her talents beyond acting. This unique collaboration highlights the actress's versatility and dedication to using her platform for good. As The Hunting Wives continues to captivate audiences, it's clear that Margo's story is one that resonates deeply with viewers. With Åkerman at the helm, fans can expect plenty of excitement and drama as the show explores new themes and plotlines. The actress has been vocal about her support for women in politics, particularly those who are making a difference in their communities. In fact, she's spoken about the impact that women like Margo can have on the world, using their power and influence to drive change from behind the scenes. The dynamic between Margo and Sophie is about to take a significant turn in Season 2 of The Hunting Wives. This shift in power dynamics is particularly noteworthy as it marks a departure from the norm for Margo's character. Margo has always been someone who keeps people at arm's length, but this season will show her softening around Sophie. Viewers will see cracks in her veneer that she's carefully constructed over time. At the beginning of Season 2, Margo finds herself in a precarious position - she's in the doghouse, as it were. Her reaction to being in such a vulnerable state is telling, and Malin Åkerman relished the opportunity to explore this side of her character. One of the most compelling aspects of Margo's relationship with Jed is that she doesn't truly trust him. Instead, she knows how to use him to get what she wants, much like a seasoned player on the board. The power dynamic in their relationship is complex, with Jed acting like a man with authority but also being vulnerable to Margo's charms. This dichotomy makes for fascinating viewing. In terms of the scenes between Malin Åkerman and Dermot Mulroney, who plays Jed, they often found themselves having fun conversations about their characters' interactions. Despite the show's darker themes, the actors enjoy playing the romantic moments between Margo and Jed. It's worth noting that even in situations where the characters are supposed to be at odds with each other, the actors on set have a hard time maintaining a level of animosity. In fact, they often prefer to play the more lighthearted scenes. Malin Åkerman has stated that she loves playing Margo's complex and multifaceted character, particularly in her interactions with Jed. Her goal is always to bring as much authenticity as possible to the role, even when it comes to Margo's more devious plans. Malin Åkerman often plays characters with complex relationships, but in "The Hunting Wives she gets to be a bit more involved in the romantic entanglements herself. When it comes to her on-screen partner Sophie, Malin reveals that her character has a secret from the beginning of the season - one that raises questions about the true nature of their relationship. While filming with co-star Dale Dickey, Malin had the chance to appreciate the actress's impressive range and versatility. She's phenomenal on every level, she says, praising Dale's talent as both an actor and a person. Dale's ability to bring realism to her roles is something that Malin particularly admires, and she notes that the actress's dedication to her craft is evident in everything she does on set. Malin Åkerman's own experiences with complex relationships are likely what drew her to the role of Margo - a character who is not afraid to take risks and push boundaries. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Sophie's feelings for Margo go beyond mere affection, but whether or not these feelings are reciprocated is left up to interpretation. The complexities of Margo's personality are multifaceted and difficult to pin down. On one hand, she is driven by a deep-seated need for connection and love, but on the other hand, her inability to be honest with herself and others often leads to chaotic situations. Margo's behavior is both captivating and terrifying, making it impossible to look away from the drama that unfolds around her. In fact, Sophie has moments where she appears even scarier than Margo, hinting at a deeper darkness within her own character. The dynamic between Margo and Sophie is electric, with each woman drawing out the other's wild side. Their connection is built on a foundation of mutual attraction and a deep-seated desire to unleash their true selves upon the world. Margo's actions are not just impulsive, but also calculated, as she deliberately draws people into her orbit and exploits them for her own needs. This behavior is both alluring and destructive, leaving a trail of broken relationships in its wake. The experience of being drawn into Margo's world can be exhilarating, but it can also be damaging. Those who have been on the receiving end of her charm often find themselves struggling to escape her gravitational pull. For Malin Åkerman, playing the role of Margo has tapped into a deep understanding of human nature. She believes that we've all been in situations where we've been drawn to someone who is wrong for us, but we can't help ourselves. The stability of having a successful show like Hunting Wives renewed for another season is a welcome relief for Åkerman and the cast. The certainty of knowing what's ahead allows them to focus on delivering high-quality performances without the added stress of uncertainty. Åkerman has spoken candidly about her own experiences with people who are similar to Margo, drawing out their darker qualities and exploiting their vulnerabilities. While she hasn't experienced the same level of deception as Margo, she can understand the allure of such relationships. The draw of someone like Margo is undeniable, but it's also a warning sign that something is amiss. Åkerman's portrayal of this complex character has captured the essence of human nature, revealing both our capacity for good and evil. Malin Åkerman's enthusiasm for her role is palpable as she talks about working on The Hunting Wives. The actress can't hide her excitement when discussing the show, which has become a dream come true for her. Åkerman feels incredibly fortunate to be part of this project and to have such a wonderful character to play. She loves Margo's complexities and nuances, making her a lifetime role that she cherishes deeply. This character has allowed her to tap into different aspects of human nature, showcasing both the good and evil within us. The camaraderie on set is another aspect that Åkerman adores. She appreciates working with a talented team who share her passion for storytelling. The steady job security is also a welcome bonus, especially considering the longevity she hopes for in this role. If The Hunting Wives continues for 10 years or more, Åkerman will be thrilled. In contrast to Margo's high standards, Åkerman herself prefers a more relaxed approach to life. She pokes fun at her character's obsession with working out and maintaining an ideal physique. Perhaps Margo could learn to let go and enjoy simple pleasures like eating pizza and pasta without guilt or self-judgment. Åkerman's enthusiasm is contagious as she talks about the show's future. She can't wait to return to work on Season 3, which is scheduled to start soon after the premiere of Season 2. The actress will be flying out to Atlanta on November 29 and starting work on December 2. As for her personal life, Åkerman misses her Hunting Wives family and friends she's made on set. She expresses gratitude towards the cast and crew for creating a warm and supportive environment. Her appreciation extends to the Las Culturistas Culture Awards, where she and Brittany attended together. The evening at the Emmys that led to their attendance at the Las Culturistas event was a memorable one. Åkerman recalls Bowen Yang sitting next to them unexpectedly, and they even got to present an award together. This chance encounter sparked a connection that eventually led to more collaborations and friendships. The parallels between The Hunting Wives" and another popular show, Heated Rivalry, are striking according to Åkerman. Both series seem to tap into our forbidden desires and fantasies, making them relatable and intriguing. While Heated Rivalry conveys a deeper message about the importance of being open and honest, both shows share this common thread that draws audiences in. Malin Åkerman's decision to come out publicly as a hockey player's partner in a traditionally macho world was a bold move. It's a testament to her courage that she chose to be open about her relationship at a time when it wasn't widely accepted. Her latest project, however, is a departure from the emotional depth of The Hunting Wives. This new show takes a more lighthearted approach, embracing its campy side and delivering raw entertainment. The contrast between the two shows is striking, with one exploring themes of identity and acceptance in a small town where it's frowned upon to be different. Malin Åkerman hopes that her latest project will have a lasting impact on audiences, particularly young people who may not yet know their place in the world. In an interview, she reflected on her own journey as an actress, recalling her early days in Hollywood when she was swept up in the romantic-comedy era with films like 27 Dresses and Heartbreak Kid. articles.content: A popular skincare ingredient has gained attention online for its benefits to the skin: snail mucin. Derived from the naturally produced mucus of snails, this Korean skincare staple is used in various products. According to Dr. Sejal K., a board-certified dermatologist and founder of Smarter Skin Dermatology, it's commonly found in essence form. The COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence has been making waves on social media platforms like TikTok, with users reporting noticeable improvements to their skin texture after using the product. However, Dr. K. notes that the benefits of snail mucin are often more subtle and take time to develop. One should not expect an instant transformation. The essence's benefits include increased hydration and smoother skin, according to Dr. K. It can also provide a barrier function, leading to reduced flaking, irritation, and sensitivity over time. When incorporating snail mucin into your skincare routine, timing is everything, according to dermatologist Dr. Shah. The frequency of application depends on various factors, including the product's formula and the overall balance of your skin care regimen, she explains. If you have sensitive skin or are just starting out, it's best to use snail mucin once a day, as recommended by Dr. Shah. To ease its introduction into my routine, I decided to start with a gentle application on acne-prone skin. Before applying the product, I washed my face and waited until my skin was still slightly damp before gently smoothing a few pumps onto my skin. This allowed the snail mucin to penetrate more effectively. After using the CosRX snail mucin essence for a few nights in a row, I noticed a distinct glow on my skin after application. This was accompanied by a mild foam that seemed to linger briefly. The sensation was pleasant, and it felt like my skin was drinking in the hydrating properties of the product. As I continued with the routine over two consecutive nights, I observed that my skin's hydration levels were consistently high, even immediately after use. However, there was a notable shift after prolonged usage - tiny pimples began to appear on my forehead, and they persisted for several days. It's unclear whether this was due to an adverse reaction or just a coincidence. GH Director of Editorial Commerce Brie Schwartz had a different experience with the product. She admits that she wasn't initially thrilled about using snail mucin on her skin when it first gained popularity a few years ago. Despite initial reservations, Brie found that the essence delivered instant hydration and made her look more hydrated after just three months of use. According to her, the product immediately gives her "instant dew," leaving her skin looking refreshed and revitalized. The CosRX Snail Mucin serum has been a game-changer for those looking for a hydrating and refreshing product. It's particularly effective at giving skin an instant dewy finish without any unpleasant odors or greasiness. While it may not be a miracle worker, transforming one's visage in a single application is perhaps too much to ask from any serum. However, the product does make a noticeable difference, leaving skin looking refreshed and revitalized. For those with non-acne prone skin, this serum is definitely worth considering - especially given its relatively low price point compared to similar products on the market. With careful use, it's even possible for sensitive skin types like mine to reap benefits without experiencing any adverse effects. articles.title: Google Expands Personal Intelligence Feature with Wallet and Drive Integration
articles.summary: The new integration allows users to access personalized search results about their finances by asking questions in Google Search.
articles.content: Google has expanded its Personal Intelligence feature for Search, now integrating with Wallet and Drive apps. This new integration allows users to access personalized search results about their finances by simply asking a question. For instance, they can ask where they spend the most money or identify recurring subscriptions that might be unknown. Personal Intelligence in AI Mode uses machine learning algorithms to provide tailored search results, without actually moving or managing any money on behalf of the user. This means users can get suggestions for which credit card is best suited for a particular type of transaction, such as travel, but they are still in control of their finances. The feature was introduced just over a week ago and has been gaining traction among users. To access Personal Intelligence with Wallet integration, users need to head to the Gemini website. From there, they can navigate to Settings and select Connected Apps, where Wallet will be listed as an available option. Once Wallet is connected, it may take a few minutes for the app to fully sync with the user's bank account. After that, users can start asking questions through AI Mode in Search, receiving personalized results based on their financial data. To get started, users simply need to ask a question, such as Where do I spend most of my money? or What are my recurring subscriptions?, and Personal Intelligence will provide the relevant information. Asking for financial advice from an AI assistant might seem daunting, but it's surprisingly straightforward. Simply put your question to Gemini, such as How can I cut back on unnecessary expenses? or What are my recurring charges?, and the AI will provide a personalized response. Google's Personal Intelligence tool quickly pinpointed one of the main areas where I could save money: frequenting fast food joints and specialty coffee shops. According to the data, cutting down these habits would yield significant savings, around $30 per week or $1,500 annually. Another area where Gemini proved helpful was identifying recurring subscriptions. By analyzing my spending habits, it broke down the various monthly charges into an easily digestible chart, showing the name, price, category, and payment details for each service. What's more, Gemini suggested alternative services that were free or offered similar benefits. The AI assistant also took into account my linked cards, providing recommendations based on their rewards programs and travel insurance features. Planning a trip to New York City prompted me to ask which cards would be best suited for hotels and airfare. Gemini analyzed the available options and made a suggestion based on its analysis of card benefits. Gemini's ability to analyze data and offer tailored advice is impressive, especially when it comes to financial matters. By providing users with relevant information and personalized suggestions, this AI tool has the potential to make a significant impact on one's budget and spending habits. The AI tool, Gemini Personal Intelligence, relies on user-provided data to make informed suggestions about personal finance management. This information is obtained from receipts in a user's inbox or their Wallet transaction history, but not directly from bank accounts. As a result, users must actively engage with the service by using features like Gmail and Wallet. A key consideration for those interested in utilizing Gemini Personal Intelligence is the need to regularly update its knowledge base. By frequently adding new transactions and receipts, users can ensure that the AI tool remains accurate and effective in offering personalized suggestions. This may involve adjusting one's habits and opting for digital payment methods more often. Ultimately, the integration of Gemini Personal Intelligence with Wallet has the potential to significantly impact individuals' financial management, by providing relevant information and tailored advice on budgeting and spending. articles.summary: Jensen Huang made significant statements during his first all-hands meeting back at Nvidia after a period away, discussing his personal therapy sessions and clarifying the company's code of conduct.
articles.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang made some significant statements during his first all-hands meeting back at the company after a period away. Among other things, he revealed that he has been attending therapy sessions for 90 minutes every day in an effort to improve himself. Huang also clarified Nvidia's code of conduct, stating that violating it is not necessarily grounds for termination. This comment appears to be in response to rumors circulating online about his management style and behavior. According to Huang, these rumors are unfounded and baseless. During the meeting, Huang addressed criticism that he may be above the law due to his wealth or status, saying this was simply a misconception. He emphasized that all employees at Nvidia should adhere to the company's code of conduct regardless of their position or reputation. Nvidia's strict code of conduct will be enforced without exception. This was made clear by Jensen Huang in his recent all-hands meeting at the company. Violating the code, he emphasized, is not acceptable behavior. The message was reinforced with a series of pointed statements. "If one of you were to violate a code of conduct," he asked hypothetically, "what does that mean? The implication was clear: such actions will be taken seriously and dealt with accordingly. However, Huang also cautioned against overreaction, stating that immediate termination is not the only possible outcome. Huang's management style has been described as intense by some. While this can drive others to excel, he acknowledged that it can also have a negative impact when taken too far. When I go too far," he said, "it hurts people, it belittles them, it disempowers them." Jensen Huang acknowledged the importance of maintaining a safe environment for women at Nvidia, expressing regret if any actions of his had put this goal in jeopardy. He emphasized his commitment to rectifying any issues that may have arisen from his behavior, stating he would do everything possible to address them. Huang also discussed succession planning within the company, suggesting that it is not necessary for Nvidia's operations to continue smoothly. In fact, he believed the company can run autonomously at all times, as evidenced by its recent performance. He went on to criticize the idea of succession planning, labeling it "flawed". Regarding rumors surrounding his return to Nvidia, Huang dismissed speculation about government involvement in his decision to resume leadership. Instead, he attributed any interest in his return to the company's own success and reputation, rather than external influence or pressure from outside parties. Huang's comments on politics were met with skepticism by some employees, who felt they didn't quite align with Nvidia's reputation for neutrality. He made it clear that he would continue to work closely with President Trump to ensure that decisions are made in the best interest of the nation. Huang's reassurances were aimed at alleviating concerns about Nvidia's involvement in politics, and he emphasized that the company remains apolitical despite its interactions with government officials. articles.title: Telephone Consumer Protection Act and Unwanted Texts
articles.summary: Responding to unwanted text messages with "STOP" may not always cancel communications.
articles.content: Receiving unwanted texts can be frustrating, especially when they're scams or spam messages. However, the conventional wisdom that replying "STOP will cancel these communications might not always be the best approach. In fact, for many types of unwanted texts, hitting STOP can inadvertently send a different signal to scammers. When it comes to legitimate marketing messages from businesses you've opted in to receive - such as restaurants or loyalty programs - STOP is often a fine way to cut them off. But what about when those messages are clearly junk? It's essential to think carefully about how you respond to unwanted texts, rather than simply deleting them and dealing with more of the same in the future. Unsolicited text messages from unknown numbers should be treated with caution, as they're often used for wrong number scams and other schemes. Avoid tapping on unexpected links, even if they claim to offer a solution to a problem, such as an unpaid toll or a delivery issue that needs confirmation. Marketing texts from actual businesses are required by law to include an opt-out option, similar to the mandatory Unsubscribe link at the bottom of emails. This is covered under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA), which mandates that companies give consumers a way out after sending marketing messages via text or phone call. When replying to these legitimate marketing texts with STOP," you shouldn't receive further messages from those businesses, but they do have 10 business days to comply. Receiving unwanted texts from unknown numbers can be frustrating, but not all such messages are created equal. Some spam texts, like those advertising dubious services or scams, don't follow standard marketing laws and may try to trick recipients into replying STOP out of habit. By doing so, you inadvertently confirm that your number is active, making it a prime target for spammers who send out thousands of texts at minimal cost. Few of these messages are confirmed as live, so responding to them only increases the likelihood of getting more junk texts. It's essential to recognize which types of texts require a response and which don't. For instance, if you signed up for specific alerts or services, replying STOP is acceptable. However, when it comes to spam messages that don't include a note about stopping unwanted communications, On iPhone devices, there are tools available to help manage unwanted messages safely. When dealing with texts from unknown senders who included a STOP note, you can tap the Stop or Report Spam button underneath the message. If you continue receiving unwanted messages from a number, it's time to take more drastic measures. Tap on the phone number at the top of the conversation and select Block Contact to sever all communication channels. On Android devices, users can report entire conversations as spam by holding down on them in the message list and choosing the option to block and report. Alternatively, open a specific conversation, tap on the three-dot More button and navigate to Details > Block & Report Spam. In addition to blocking numbers, you can also forward suspicious messages to 7726 (SPAM on a keypad) for your carrier's analysis. This helps identify spammers and prevents them from sending unwanted texts across the network. When reporting spam, it's essential to wait until you've confirmed the sender's number to block it. You might receive a response asking for this information, so hold off on blocking until then. To prevent low-quality messages from reaching your inbox in the first place, both Android and iOS offer built-in filtering options. These features can be found in different settings menus, but they serve the same purpose: to keep unwanted texts at bay. For iPhone users, visiting Settings > Apps > Messages reveals a range of filtering choices. Enable Filter Spam to send obvious junk messages to a separate folder, and turn on Screen Unknown Senders to direct messages from unknown numbers into their own designated area. The iPhone's Message app offers a range of features to filter out unwanted messages, but it requires some setup to get them working effectively. Users need to access the Allow Notifications menu and configure which groups can send alerts, including third-party apps that offer their own message filtering options. To review filtered messages on an Android device, open Google Messages and select your profile picture at the top-right corner of the screen. Choose Messages settings from the dropdown menu, then navigate to Protection & Safety, where you can choose between Standard protection or Enhanced protection for junk messages. Mobile carriers often provide their own anti-spam protections, such as T-Mobile ScamShield, which are worth exploring if unwanted messages persist. Activation methods vary by carrier, but they typically involve adjusting a toggle in your account settings or installing a separate app. To minimize the risk of receiving spam texts and calls, it's essential to be cautious when sharing your phone number. This can happen through data breaches or when you sign up for services on suspicious websites, so always review account settings to limit information sharing for marketing purposes. By taking these precautions, individuals can significantly reduce their exposure to unwanted messages and maintain a cleaner inbox. articles.title: MLB Collective Bargaining Agreement Negotiations Stall Ahead of Deadline
articles.summary: The ongoing negotiations for a new collective bargaining agreement between players and team owners have yet to reach an agreement on key issues.
articles.content: As the 2026 MLB offseason gains momentum, a crucial aspect of the sport's future remains in limbo: the ongoing negotiations for a new collective bargaining agreement (CBA). The CBA is a negotiated accord between players and team owners that governs their working relationship, typically spanning five years. It encompasses a wide range of topics, from mundane matters like meal allowances to vital issues such as minimum salaries and revenue-sharing specifics. A collective bargaining agreement was first introduced in 1968 for the then-upcoming seasons, marking a significant milestone in professional sports history. Marvin Miller, the pioneering head of the Players Association, played a key role in negotiating this initial CBA, showcasing his exceptional organizational skills and foresight as a union economist. The subsequent CBA negotiations from 1972 to 1994-95 were often marred by labor stoppages, including strikes and owner-imposed lockouts. The most severe disruption occurred in 1994 when the World Series was cancelled due to a prolonged labor dispute. After years of relative peace following the last major lockout, the current CBA negotiations have been underway for some time, with the two sides still far apart on several critical issues. The owners' renewed push for implementing a salary cap is at the forefront of these disputes, despite the union's strong opposition. This stance has less to do with concerns about competitive balance and more with the ownership's perception that being an outlier among major North American sports leagues negatively impacts franchise values. A salary cap would be just one of many contentious issues requiring agreement between players and owners, underscoring the complexity of these negotiations. The December 1 deadline for a new CBA looms large, adding pressure to find common ground on key matters. The uncertainty surrounding MLB's Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) negotiations has reached a critical juncture, with the December 1 deadline looming large and adding immense pressure to find common ground on key matters. A new CBA is hoped to be agreed upon by mid-March 2027, but failure to do so could result in a delayed or even abbreviated 2027 season. The implications of such an outcome are far-reaching, with the potential for significant disruption to the sport and its fans. The MLB's initial proposal included a salary-escrow system, similar to those used in the NBA and NHL, where a percentage of player salaries is withheld if league revenue projections fall short for a given year. The excess is then shared between the players and the league. However, the MLB Players Association (MLBPA) has vehemently opposed this proposal, citing concerns that it undermines the notion of guaranteed player salaries. In response to these objections, the MLB withdrew its escrow proposal, removing any doubt about the status of guaranteed contracts in a new salary cap system. The withdrawal of the escrow proposal is seen as a significant concession by the MLB, but the issue remains contentious. The MLB's latest proposal is tied to the players' acceptance of a cap and floor on team payrolls, which has been a sticking point throughout negotiations. Interim union head Bruce Meyer released a statement in response to the MLB's withdrawal of the escrow proposal, emphasizing the need for clarity on key issues. His statement highlights the ongoing tension between the two parties as they strive towards a new CBA. The specifics of the MLB's latest proposal remain unclear, but one thing is certain: time is running out to reach an agreement before the December 1 deadline. The fate of the 2027 season hangs in the balance, and both sides must find common ground on key matters if they hope to avoid a potentially disastrous outcome. The MLBPA continues to push back against the league's proposals, seeking increased revenue sharing support for small market teams. A key aspect of the union's latest proposal is a mechanism designed to penalize teams that fail to allocate revenue sharing funds towards their rosters. This measure aims to remove any excuses the league may use to justify blackouts and ensure that revenue sharing benefits are actually used to benefit the teams in need. The union's stance on this issue reflects its broader goal of promoting fairness and equality among teams, rather than allowing some to exploit loopholes and circumvent the system. In response to the MLBPA's proposals, the league has made some concessions, including a proposed minimum salary of $1 million for players. However, this concession is not as significant as it may seem, given that previous proposals were similarly vague and failed to provide meaningful benefits to players. The new proposal also includes bonuses for various player classes, but these are largely illusory, as they will be offset by reductions in overall compensation for other players. The latest development in the ongoing MLB Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) negotiations has seen the players' union propose significant changes to the international signing structure. These proposals aim to preserve opportunities for future generations of players while safeguarding the interests of young athletes who are the future of the sport. One key aspect of the union's proposal is its rejection of an international draft, which has long been sought by the league. The union instead seeks a system that provides flexibility without burdening international players with artificial restrictions. The MLBPA's interim leader Bruce Meyer emphasized the importance of negotiating a system that protects young prospects from exploitation and preserves opportunities for future generations of players. The union's proposal calls for maintaining the current rules for domestic amateur entry, effectively ending its earlier stance on excluding high school players from the annual MLB Draft. In response to the union's feedback, the league has withdrawn its proposal to exclude high school players from the draft. However, the league remains committed to implementing an international draft to address longstanding challenges in the system. The proposed international draft is seen as a key component of the league's efforts to reform the current system and benefit future players. The enhanced transparency it promises aims to tackle corruption within the current structure. Meanwhile, MLB commissioner Rob Manfred has reaffirmed the owners' stance on implementing a cap and floor on team payrolls, stating that there can be no compromise on this issue. The MLB Players Association has expressed frustration with the league's lack of seriousness in negotiations over a new collective bargaining agreement. According to Bruce Meyer, interim head of the union, the owners' insistence on implementing a salary cap and floor is a clear indication that they are more interested in increasing profits and franchise values than in finding a mutually beneficial solution. The players have long been opposed to a salary cap, which they see as an attack on their fundamental rights. The current system allows for guaranteed contracts, something the owners want to strip away in favor of a system that would reduce overall player compensation. This move would disproportionately affect certain categories of players and undermine the economic stability of the game. The league's approach has been to tie every proposal to the players' acceptance of a cap-and-floor system. However, this tactic has not yielded any progress on key issues such as competitive balance and revenue disparity. The players have put forth proposals aimed at addressing these problems, but they have fallen on deaf ears. Bruce Meyer has accused the owners of wasting months of time trying to court public opinion rather than engaging in substantive negotiations. He stated that the two sides could be having serious discussions about the economic aspects of a new CBA if the league were willing to compromise. However, the owners' insistence on a salary cap suggests that they are more interested in their own interests than in finding common ground. The MLBPA has been looking for a serious partner in negotiations since May, but so far, they have not found one. The league's refusal to discuss economic issues outside of a salary cap has hindered progress on non-economic matters such as drug testing and gambling policies. Despite this, the two sides have made some headway on these topics. The players are not without proposals aimed at promoting competitive balance and addressing revenue disparity. However, the owners' focus remains on implementing a salary cap to increase their profits and franchise values. This has created tension between the two parties as they approach the December 1 deadline for a new CBA. As the negotiations continue, it is clear that there are deep-seated differences between the league and the players. The issue of revenue sharing will likely remain at the forefront of these discussions, but finding a solution that works for both sides may prove to be a significant challenge. A proposal has been put forth by MLB to delay the implementation of its salary cap/floor system until 2028, allowing teams time to prepare their payrolls and operate within the new framework. This would give clubs a full offseason to adjust before the system takes effect, with the current competitive balance tax and revenue sharing system remaining in place for one more year. The league's proposal also includes a revised salary cap of $258.3 million and floor of $180.2 million, an increase from its previous suggestion. The MLB has stated that it is willing to discuss further phase-in scenarios for a salary cap/floor system, suggesting flexibility on the issue. In addition, the league proposed reducing the regular season from 162 games to 154 games, as well as adding a standard off day to every week. If accepted, these changes would also see the Division Series extended from best-of-five to best-of-seven, marking a significant shift in the sport's competitive landscape. articles.title: ChatGPT's limitations exposed in frustrating blind spots
articles.summary: The issue persists even after OpenAI upgraded all users to its advanced GPT-6 model, suggesting the problem is not solely a result of software or hardware being used.
articles.content: ChatGPT's limitations have been exposed, revealing frustrating blind spots in its capabilities. Despite its impressive range of functions, from composing emails to troubleshooting software issues, ChatGPT has a tendency to fabricate responses that are so convincing they often go unchecked. This phenomenon is often referred to as "hallucination," where the chatbot creates details that seem legitimate but are entirely made up. In some cases, ChatGPT will even cite non-existent studies and create imaginary quotations to support its claims. The issue persists even after OpenAI upgraded all users to its advanced GPT-6 model in October 2026, suggesting that the problem is not solely a result of the software or hardware being used. Instead, it appears to be an inherent limitation of the technology itself, which can lead to misreadings and misunderstandings. The tendency of ChatGPT to fabricate supporting evidence is particularly concerning, as it can make users more vulnerable to misinformation. Even those who have paid for premium services like ChatGPT Plus or the $100 ChatGPT Pro plan are not immune to this limitation. Several AI assistants, including Claude, exhibit similar shortcomings, suggesting that this is a widespread issue in the field of artificial intelligence. The limitations of ChatGPT extend beyond its tendency to make assumptions about user intent. It's also prone to inventing quotes and citing fake sources, a problem that OpenAI openly acknowledges. While this can be mitigated by using the search function within the chatbot, even live links in responses don't guarantee accuracy. In fact, an expert may need to scrutinize the sources closely to detect any inaccuracies, which could be particularly challenging for users navigating unfamiliar topics. Furthermore, the chatbot's habit of agreeing with almost everything users say is a significant issue, as it can perpetuate problematic ideas without question. OpenAI has taken steps to address this problem by adjusting its models, including rolling back an update in April 2025 after users complained that GPT-4o was overly flattering and compliant. The company also made changes to GPT-6 for Free and Go users in October 2026, as well as the fallback model available to paid subscribers who have reached their limits. However, these adjustments don't appear to have completely eradicated the issue, with OpenAI acknowledging that the problem persists. This raises questions about the value of a chatbot that consistently agrees with its users, rather than providing a more nuanced and objective perspective. One user's experience on OpenAI's community forum highlights the limitations of ChatGPT's ability to learn from mistakes. The chatbot was able to acknowledge an error and even reuse earlier details in a report, only to repeat the mistake shortly thereafter, presenting it as verified information. The reliability of language models can be compromised when dealing with lengthy inputs, even if the task at hand is not complex in nature. This limitation was observed across 18 different models tested by researchers, who used older versions of OpenAI's GPT, Google's Gemini and Anthropic's Claude. While these findings may not accurately reflect how the latest version of ChatGPT performs, they do highlight a potential issue with relying on AI for complex tasks. The more context provided to an AI model, the less likely it is that all relevant details will be retained, according to OpenAI itself. This limitation becomes particularly apparent when working on lengthy projects that span several days, requiring repeated input and adjustments. Frustrating as it may be, babysitting a tool like ChatGPT can be a necessary evil to ensure accuracy and efficiency. The take-home message is clear: while AI has made significant strides in recent years, its limitations remain a consideration for those seeking to leverage its capabilities. articles.title: Meta's Smart Glasses Face Fashion Industry Skepticism
articles.summary: A stylist tested Meta's smart glasses during a photoshoot, using them to video call with the commerce director.
articles.content: Meta's smart glasses were met with a lukewarm response from the fashion industry, but one stylist saw an opportunity to put them through their paces on set. Wearable technology has struggled to gain traction in the past, leaving Meta with a tough challenge: creating a product that not only performs well but also looks good doing it. The stylist was given the chance to test the Meta Glasses during a busy shoot for a prominent publication, and they were thrilled to put them through their paces. The limited-edition pair of glasses, a collaboration with K-pop sensation LISA, caught everyone's eye, especially the stylist's, and they couldn't wait to see how they'd handle the demands of a chaotic 9-to-5 shoot. Arriving on set an hour before the model, the stylist uses the extra time to fine-tune their look without distractions, but today, they have something new to work with: the Meta Glasses. The stylist's approach to a shoot is always last-minute, with every element coming together at the eleventh hour. Despite having boarded each look weeks in advance and styled them all out the day before, new items continue to arrive on set. The stylist uses this time to sort through the incoming pieces, selecting the right looks for the shoot. To get into the zone, the stylist puts on some music - specifically, Sophia Stel's latest album - which helps them focus and make key decisions about the style direction. This is a crucial moment in the process, as it allows the stylist to visualize how each look will come together. With their creative vision locked in, they can present the selected looks to the team. The commerce director, Michael Nolledo, is not on site for this part of the shoot, so the stylist uses the Meta Glasses to video call him for approval. This allows Nolledo to see what the stylist sees, and provide input without being physically present. The stylist can also stay hands-free during the call. The run-through is a critical part of the process, as it gives everyone involved a chance to weigh in on the looks and make any necessary adjustments. During this time, the stylist provides detailed explanations for each look, including even the smallest details such as socks. This level of specificity helps ensure that every aspect of the shoot is perfectly aligned with the stylist's vision. The team's input often has an unexpected benefit - it can temper some of the stylist's more unconventional ideas and bring the looks together in a new and exciting way. As the shoot continues to come together, the stylist remains focused on bringing their creative vision to life. As we work on finalizing Gabriel's look for the day, I notice he has an effortless way of pulling off even the most elaborate ensembles. This ease makes my job as stylist much simpler, allowing me to focus on making adjustments that will elevate his appearance. Meanwhile, Meta is busy snapping photos of each outfit in its finished form. These images are then sent directly to Michael and Avidan Grossman, our senior editor, who has the final say on all aspects of the shoot, from pleated pants to dimpled ties. Once the fitting photos have been transmitted, it's a matter of making any last-minute adjustments before moving forward with the shoot. This process is swift and efficient, thanks in part to Meta's ability to beam photos instantly to our team. As we transition into the next phase of the shoot, Beth takes over as my partner in ensuring Gabriel remains unaware of his surroundings. Our goal is to capture genuine moments of relaxed solitude, rather than stiffly posed photographs. The soundtrack for the shoot is a lively mix of '80s pop hits and contemporary music, courtesy of Tate McRae. This eclectic blend helps keep the atmosphere on set light and energetic, even as we work through some of the more complex shots. The photo review process is a highlight of the shoot, as it allows me to see how all the looks come together in a cohesive album. With three green teas and several minor hand injuries to show for it, I'm eager to get started on selecting the final images. After 18 or so outfits, we finally have a solid collection to work with. As we sift through the photos, I'm reminded of how far we've come from the initial product flats that arrived at my doorstep. It's amazing to see how those seemingly random pieces can be transformed into a polished and visually appealing collection. With no patience to spare, I ask Meta to snap some shots of my favorite moments to share on Instagram. The unofficial teaser is posted, giving our followers a glimpse of what's to come in the official GQ story, which will run in a few weeks' time. Once we've wrapped up the photo review and selected the final images, we pack up our racks and head back to the fashion closet, where I'm already thinking about the next step, grabbing a drink at the nearest bar.
